gaps.next_text: It looks like the Families have wiped all competition from the galaxy

gaps.prev_text: is what to do with all that Dust...

cues.text: A pale woman in a high-collared gown sits on a smooth orb, holding a glowing golden sphere.

The glowing golden grid beneath her stretches endlessly into space. Behind her, a vast starry nebula swirls in vibrant green. Towering shafts of light rise from the grid into the cosmos, dwarfing her against the infinite expanse. Everything fades to black.

beats.note: A pale woman in a high-collared gown sits cross-legged on a smooth orb, holding a glowing golden sphere in her palm.
She sits upon a glowing golden grid that stretches out in all directions.
A vast starry nebula in shades of green becomes visible behind her as she slowly shrinks in the frame.
Shafts of golden light begin to rise from the grid into the sky.
The grid stretches endlessly into the cosmos, dwarfing her against the vast expanse.
